title: Barnard B005 envelope verifier CLI JSON (v1)
description: Strict stdin request and successful stdout receipt for the offline B005 verifier CLI. A successful receipt represents RADIO_SELF_VERIFIED at the supplied ENIN, not registry confirmation.

signedEnvelopeHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal signed envelope bytes without the four-byte B005 container (199 to 508 bytes).

currentEnin.description: ENIN supplied by the caller for offline verification; not independently established wall-clock time.

kind.description: Versioned CLI receipt kind for RADIO_SELF_VERIFIED only; not a registration or user-facing verified state.

relayExpiresAtEnin.description: Exclusive end of the half-open relay window, not proof that the event is registered or physically present.
